questions.text: A park is designed in the shape of a right-angled triangle, where the two shorter sides measure 13 m and 84 m. A circular track with a uniform width of 2 m is constructed such that its outer boundary coincides with the circumcircle of the triangular park. Determine the perimeter of the inner boundary of this circular track. Ans A. B. C. D.

Ram has ₹1000 in the denomination of ₹10, ₹20 and ₹5 notes. If the number of ₹10 notes is 16 more than that of ₹20 notes and the number of ₹5 notes is twice the number of ₹20 notes, find the total number of notes that Ram has.
Pooja gets a discount of 17% on a dryer whose marked price is ₹2,000. Since she pays by credit card, she gets an additional 10% discount. How much does she pay (in ₹)?
At present, a father is 30 years older than his son. In 12 years, the father will be three times as old as his son. What is the present age of the son?
The difference between a discount of 35% and two successive discounts of 20% and 15% on a certain marked price is ₹70. Find the marked price (rounded off to the nearest integer).
Find the value of m which satisfies Ans A. B. C. D.

Two taps can fill a cistern in 4 hours and 8 hours, respectively. A third tap can empty it in 4 hours. How long (in hours) will it take to fill one-fourth of the empty cistern if all the taps are opened together?

Yogesh invested a certain sum of money at 10% per annum. After 2 years, he received ₹147 as compound interest, compounded annually. Find the corresponding simple interest (in ₹) for 2 years at the same rate.
A sum of ₹25,000 is invested at 2% per annum compounded annually. Find the compound interest after 2 years.
Find the measure of the unknown interior angle in an irregular hexagon with angles 140°, 80°, 145°, 155°, and 100°.3534

The enrolment of students in an institution increased by 10% in April compared to the number of students in March and then decreased by 5%, resulting in 1045 students in June. Find the number of students in March.
If 9 workers can build a wall in 12 days, how many days will 6 workers take to build the same wall, assuming they work at the same rate?
If the third proportional to 4 and 6 is used as the base of a rectangle, and the first number (4) is its height, what is the area of the rectangle?

Two taps can fill a cistern in 4 hours and 8 hours, respectively. A third tap can empty it in 4 hours. How long (in hours) will it take to fill one-fourth of the empty cistern if all the taps are opened together?
In a science experiment, chemicals X, Y, and Z are mixed in the ratio 5:2:3. If the total weight of the mixture is 100 grams, how much of chemical Y is present?
The angle of elevation of the top of a tree from a point on the ground is 30°. After moving 10 m towards the tree, the angle of elevation becomes 60°. Find the height of the tree. Ans A. B. C. D.
A man is walking at 4 km/hr. A 180 m long train crosses him in 12 seconds while coming from the opposite direction. What is the speed of the train (in km/hr)?

A keg is fitted with three taps A, B and C. If opened together, all the three taps will drain the full keg in minutes. Taps A and B together take 3 minutes to drain the keg while taps B and C together take minutes to drain it. How long (in minutes) taps A and C together take to drain the keg? Ans A. B. C. D.
What is the arithmetic mean of the dataset {12, 25, 37, 48, 56, 61, 73, 85, 92, 104}?

A shopkeeper offers the following schemes on toys of the same marked price. (A) Successive discounts of 35% and 4% on any number of toys bought. (B) Successive discounts of 45%, 46% and 50% on any number of toys bought. (C) 15% discount on the first 3 toys and 5% discount on each toy thereon. (D) 2 toys free of cost on buying 9 toys. A customer wants to buy 9 toys. Which of the above schemes is the least beneficial to her?
Two solid hemispheres are joined together to make a sphere. The total surface area of solids reduced by approximately ___%.

Two trains, A and B, start simultaneously from stations Delhi and Mumbai respectively towards each other on parallel tracks. After meeting, train A takes 16 hours to reach Mumbai, and train B takes 9 hours to reach Delhi. If train A’s speed is 60 km/h, what is the length of train B (in meters), given that it crosses a pole in 18 seconds?

The expenditures of R are 65% of his salary. If his salary increased by 10% and his savings are ₹3,150 more than previous savings, his expenditures are now 60% of his salary. His present salary is ₹______.
Three numbers are in the ratio 17 : 13 : 8, and their LCM is 7072. Their HCF is:8620
Lekhraj sells an article at a profit of 25%. If the cost price is increased by 20% and the selling price is reduced by 10%, what percentage loss will Lekhraj incur?
The average of 5 consecutive integers is 10. What is the smallest integer?
If x is the mean proportional between (a+b) and (a-b), then find the value of x. Ans A. B. C. D.
